elements.text: You recently visited a friend that you hadn’t seen in a long time, and when you get back, you find out that your partner has woken up with a sore throat. Your partner is getting a COVID test today, but you are worried about the results and scared you may have accidentally exposed your friend. You think about what will happen if your partner tests positive and feel your friend will understand and forgive...
